stage_2_override.goal_text: Audit and document whether causal mechanism graphs apply to AIMech's native AI-concept domain and schema, using its local record-review skill and full corpus inventory. Preserve the ontology/causality distinction and report inapplicability with evidence; do not invent biological data or unsupported fields. If a real applicable representation is discovered, report it for review before replacing this applicability objective.
stage_2_override.applicability_reason: AI-concept records do not currently have a supported biological causal-graph or UniProt protein-example scope. Perform the explicit native-domain applicability audit, retain evidence, and keep the stage closure.

aimech.name: aimech
aimech.description: A provenance-bearing projection of AIO terminology, with separately curated evidence and discussions. Ontology membership does not establish efficacy, benchmark performance, safety, or causal mechanism.

mech_shared.name: mech_shared
mech_shared.description:
Canonical, byte-identical LinkML module shared across the Mech knowledge bases (CultureMech / MIM / CommunityMech / TraitMech). It carries three domain-general record sections ported from monarch-initiative/dismech:

  * Discussion — the discourse / "knowledge gap" layer. A broad supertype
    (kind = KNOWLEDGE_GAP, OPEN_QUESTION, CONTROVERSY, CURATION_TODO,
    EMERGING_HYPOTHESIS, INTERPRETATION, HUMAN_MODEL_MISMATCH) with a
    lifecycle status, hash-anchor `attaches_to` pointers into the importing
    record's sections, optional `proposed_experiments` resolution sketches,
    and a `SupportingReference` evidence block.

  * Dataset — a lightweight reference to a public dataset (omics, sequence,
    phenotype). Its `dataset_type` / `repository` enums are the faithful UNION
    of the existing CultureMech and CommunityMech enums (plus microbial
    additions) so the Phase-2 migration of those two repos is loss-preserving.

  * CrossCorpusLink — a provenance-bearing link to a record in another Mech.
    The importing schema owns the relation vocabulary and which slots admit
    links. Sharing a protein or a reaction supplies a curation lead, not an
    assertion of record equivalence or biological mechanism.

The module is SELF-CONTAINED: it defines its own `SupportingReference` evidence class (and `SupportLevelEnum`) rather than referencing each repo's `EvidenceItem`, so it validates standalone, imposes no per-repo dependency (MIM has `MappingEvidence`, not `EvidenceItem`), and never collides with an importing schema's classes. Each record keeps its own primary `EvidenceItem` for record-level claims; discussions/datasets carry their own lightweight `SupportingReference` citations.
Vendored byte-identical and sha-pinned across the Mech repos (see culturebotai-claw#7). Do not edit one copy in isolation — change it once and re-vendor + re-pin everywhere.

causal_or_graphical_subject_records.name: Bayesian Network
causal_or_graphical_subject_records.definition: A network that is a probabilistic graphical model representing variables and their conditional dependencies via a directed acyclic graph.

causal_or_graphical_subject_records.name: Causal Graphical Model
causal_or_graphical_subject_records.definition: A probabilistic graphical model used to encode assumptions about the data-generating process.

causal_or_graphical_subject_records.name: Causal LLM
causal_or_graphical_subject_records.definition: A large language model that only attends to previous tokens in the sequence when generating text modeling the probability distribution autoregressively from left-to-right or causally.

causal_or_graphical_subject_records.name: Generative Commonsense LLM
causal_or_graphical_subject_records.definition: A large language model that is trained to understand and model basic physics causality and common sense about how the real world works.

causal_or_graphical_subject_records.name: Probabilistic Graphical Model
causal_or_graphical_subject_records.definition: A machine learning task in which a graph expresses the conditional dependence structure between random variables.

causal_or_graphical_subject_records.name: Probabilistic Topic Model
causal_or_graphical_subject_records.definition: A probabilistic graphical model that uses statistical techniques to analyze the words in each text to discover common themes their connections and their changes over time.

ontology_vs_causality_distinction.aio_taxonomic_subsumption: 442 parents edges across 442 generated AIO records represent OWL/RDFS class subsumption (rdfs:subClassOf / owl:Thing), not causal state transitions.
ontology_vs_causality_distinction.aio_mereological_relationships: 71 exported relationships use BFO:0000051 ('has part'), which src/aimech/schema/aimech.yaml explicitly defines as 'has part; exported ontology axiom, not evidence of causal effect.'
ontology_vs_causality_distinction.curated_aio_vocabulary_mappings: 1822 aio_mappings across 1338 curated records (plus 149 aio_no_match records) express conceptual scope alignment (broad_match, narrow_match, related_match) to pinned AIO classes, not causal edges.
ontology_vs_causality_distinction.curated_mechanism_claims: 2793 ConceptClaim entries with kind='mechanism' (out of 5149 total claims across 1,487 curated records) document mathematical, algorithmic, or architectural operating mechanisms in natural-language prose backed by primary literature locators, not biological or physical causal mechanism graphs.
ontology_vs_causality_distinction.ai_causal_inference_subject_matter: 6 generated AIO records and 80 maintained curated records match causal/graphical terminology in their definitions, identity notes, or claims across four methodological categories: (1) statistical causal inference, instrumental-variable estimation, and counterfactual fairness criteria; (2) probabilistic graphical models and Bayesian-network inference/diagnostics; (3) causal/autoregressive sequence masking, non-anticipative system identification, and algorithmic directed acyclic graphs (e.g. shortest-path DAGs); and (4) explicit limitation-claim disclaimers noting that benchmark graph examples do not establish causal biology. None of these records encode biological causal mechanism graphs.

future_representation_assessment.candidate_native_analog: No applicable causal-mechanism-graph representation exists in AIMech's current schemas (src/aimech/schema/aimech.yaml and src/aimech/schema/curated_concept.yaml). If a future schema revision ever introduces structured algorithmic operator-dataflow or mathematical dependency graphs, that representation would denote formal computational composition rather than empirical biological/mechanistic causality and would require explicit schema governance review before replacing Stage 2's applicability audit objective.
